title: fix(router): skip history push on browser back and forward actions
body:

Issue was reported here https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/4740
The main issue is that after popstate event is fired, router.write method is called where pushState confuse the browser history. So next time you try to go back wrong state will be used. Fix will prevent pushState on popstate event.

I think the idea of this fix is correct, thanks!  however it might be more correct to avoid the write in routing manager if it came from the callback of onUpdate, what do you think?

I was thinking about to implement on the router middleware level, but history.ts has setWindowTitle function. It won't be called if avoid the write method call.
On the other hand, fix on router manager level will prevent such issue with browser history for any other routers.. But in case of `popstate` event this issue related only to history router..
Hmm, I think I almost agree with you..)
So, should I do changes in the same branch/PR or we will keep the current commit?
I've double checked and I think we have to keep the check on history router level as it's the issue related on this, not on Router Manager.
